entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can't believe we couldn't find[n]a single table...
entries.uk: Не віриться, що ми не знайшли[n]жодного вільного столика...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: At least we can try to get a cake here,[n]but... even this place is so crowded.
entries.uk: Тут можна хоча б спробувати купити[n]торт, але... навіть тут стільки людей.

entries.en: Let's have faith.
No harm in trying.
I'm fine if I'm with you.
entries.uk: З тобою мені й так добре.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yeah. You're right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's get going.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: True. No point getting our hopes up,[n]but let's keep trying.
entries.uk: Це так. Надто сподіватися не варто,[n]але спробуймо ще.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Th-Thank you. I feel the same way...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait, focus! We've got a cake to buy!
entries.uk: Стоп, зосередься! Нам ще торт купувати!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's get going.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It doesn't look like they have anything...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh well. Maybe we'd better find[n]another place.
entries.uk: Що ж. Мабуть, краще пошукати[n]інше місце.

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Staff
entries.en: You're not in the market for a Christmas[n]cake, are you?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: O-Oh, um... We are, actually.

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Staff
entries.en: Ah, fantastic...

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Staff
entries.en: One of our orders was canceled last-[n]minute.
entries.uk: Одне із замовлень скасували[n]в останню мить.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're kidding!

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Staff
entries.en: I guess it's your lucky night! So, do you[n]want to buy it?
entries.uk: Мабуть, сьогодні вам щастить![n]То що, купуватимете?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well... if it's really all right...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Then yes. We'll take it.

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Staff
entries.en: Of course! Just wait one moment[n]while I go prepare your order!
entries.uk: Звісно! Зачекайте хвилинку,[n]я підготую ваше замовлення!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm honestly stunned. This kind of thing[n]never happens, right?
entries.uk: Я, чесно, приголомшена. Такого ж[n]не буває, правда?

entries.en: Let's call it karma.
Your good deeds paid off.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sure. We'll go with that.
